body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Motorola showcased its Android-powered phone 'Backflip' at CES 2010, which comes with unique reverse flip design and Qwerty keyboard that make it easy to enjoy multimedia content and social network message.
Adopting a 3.1-inch HVGA screen, the Motorola Backflip features 3G/Wi-Fi access, a 5M camera with flash, AGPS support and more.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
